canonicalReason: Current pack-back photo (tier 1) and the Rossmann DE product page (private-label owner) give an identical 26-item list in the same order; the barcode on the photo equals the catalog GTIN and the 300 ml volume matches. The prior 2026-09-02 Rossmann DK capture is also identical.
normalization: Split the canonical raw INCI on ',' (not on commas inside locants such as '1,2-'), merged split synonym entries such as 'Aqua (Water)' / 'Aqua/Water/Eau' into one item each; per ingredient: lower-case, trim, collapse internal whitespace, remove whitespace around '/'; drop a trailing period and any leading label such as 'Inhaltsstoffe:'; keep parentheses, asterisks and hyphens as published; join the normalized ingredients with '|' and sha256 the UTF-8 string.
notes: Prior capture (shampoo-manifest-scannable-14, 2026-09-02, rossmann.dk) carried the same list; list unchanged. The prior list had no trailing period; the DE page and the pack photo end 'Gossypium Herbaceum Flower Extract.' (period stripped).
I read the pack-back photo at screen resolution (displayed downscaled); the photo text and the page text agree item by item.

Claims 'Baumwollblumen- und Kornblumen-Extrakt' = Gossypium Herbaceum Flower Extract + Centaurea Cyanus Flower Extract (both present, last positions); 'Panthenol' present; 'ohne Silikone' consistent. Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein present (wheat-derived; no gluten-free claim made).
Retailer text on rossmann.de: 'ISANA Shampoo Sensitiv'; catalog name adds the 'Baumwoll- & Kornblume' variant descriptor from the front pack.
